description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'OrganizationalCurrencyNotFoundException' used when a currency is not supported or cannot be found within an organization in the Fineract project.

classes.name: OrganizationalCurrencyNotFoundException
classes.description: A specialized runtime exception indicating that a specified currency code is invalid or not supported within the organization.

methods.name: OrganizationalCurrencyNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new instance of this exception with an error message based on the currency code.
